record.title: DfCM reachable frontier
record.body: Current reachable frontier after R63 containment: execute R63 allocation courts against assimilated R61/R62 evidence; measure clean positive relief, actionable-opportunity yield, consumer breadth, evidence-root breadth and temporal causality; allocate next capital to highest clean marginal-yield independent consumer/composition; reconstitute R54 independence semantics only onto current main rather than merging stale lineage; preserve consumer and cross-repo composition alternatives until exact receipts exist.
